descriptive_intervals.unit: paired record means per source and gap; repeated subjects limit exchangeability

aggregation: Mean within record then equal records within source and gap. Paired differences candidate minus baseline. Shared individuals limit inference.
seed_rule: 78000000+100*window_index+condition_index, in manifest order; gap,noise,turnover,clutter Cartesian product.
stop_rule: Single frozen scoring pass. No tuning on these sources. Previously prepared trajectory references can contain source preprocessing prior to artificial gap masking.
